comment: Portable subscription transport manifest. Anchor preferences alone choose production families; shared verified capability policy selects latest-supported/highest-supported models. Actual author and served-model provenance are required for cross-family verification. Local deterministic/experimental tools remain installation-specific and are never automatic subscription fallbacks.

cross_family.note: Configured independent subscription verification requires actual served-model attestation and successful integrity sentinels. An unavailable, substituted or unattested verification seat fails closed; there is no implicit local-model fallback.
cross_family.primary_resolution: Anchor primary settings, or mirror only when primary is absent: review_family then coding_family that differs from the recorded actual author; none means explicit unverified/fail-closed status.

gemini.role: F1-cross-family-seat (only when a pref names gemini)
gemini.note: Gemini is eligible only when configured, through verified agy-dispatch subscription capabilities. Until latest-model/highest-effort discovery is established, fail before launch; do not use historical labels.

grok.note: The Grok seat: the subscription Grok Build CLI (`grok.exe -p`, plan permission mode for a refuter) — never the raw xAI HTTP API. Env-gated (CRUCIBLE_AGENT_LIVE=1).

chatgpt.note: ChatGPT uses the subscription Codex CLI, read-only for verification, with current capability-selected model and highest effort; never an API-key transport.

claude.role: F1-cross-family-seat (only for a claim NOT authored by Claude)
claude.note: Claude uses the subscription CLI and shared current model/effort policy. Independent verification requires a different recorded actual author family.

lean.note: Core Lean only; mathlib (multi-GB) FLAGGED follow-on. Verified 1+1=2 := rfl -> exit 0, 1+1=3 := rfl -> exit 1.

lake.note: Lean build driver; pinned for completeness. Core Lean only (no mathlib this increment).

z3.note: Used ONLY within z3-DECIDABLE theories (LIA/LRA/BV); quantified number-theory/analysis is out of scope this increment (fail-CLOSED on unknown). Verified sat/unsat.

ollama.note: Explicit experimental local-model panel only, not a production preference seat or automatic fallback. It requires actual generator-family provenance and its own integrity sentinels.

cross_family_probe.note: P8 probabilistic-class integrity: N=5 trials at deterministic decoding on a known-true + known-false battery (5/5 each) PLUS a proof-JUDGING sentinel (a planted plausible-but-wrong proof the panel MUST reject). A model that accepts the wrong proof is QUARANTINED from the PLAUSIBILITY-CORROBORATED path.

faithfulness_instance_battery.comment: Wave-4 (F2+F3) reads this. The metamorphic concrete-instance battery is tool/cross-family/human/PRNG-sourced (NEVER Claude-enumerated), provenance-stamped, coupled to a non-vacuity check.

local_tool_setup: Example paths only: install and configure optional local tools on this host before enabling RAMANUJAN_TOOL_TESTS. These paths do not assert installation or verification and do not change subscription family preferences.
